# Pastikan anda sudah menggunakan RouterOS v7 terbaru
# Pastikan anda sudah membuat profile dengan nama "ISOLIR"
# Teliti dulu sebelum melakukan copy paste script
## Router Reporter Generated by Dev'Hunter Security ##

:local botToken "{isi token bot}";

:local chatId "{isi chat id}";
:local ifaceA "{sesuaikan dengan nama interface WAN}";

:local rxA [/interface get [find name=$ifaceA] rx-byte]
:local txA [/interface get [find name=$ifaceA] tx-byte]

:local rxMBA ($rxA / 1024 / 1024)
:local txMBA ($txA / 1024 / 1024)

:local sysName [/system identity get name]
:local sysNameTrans $sysName

:local model [/system resource get board-name]
:local uptime [/system resource get uptime]
:local version [/system resource get version]
:local cpuLoad [/system resource get cpu-load]

:local hotspot [/ip hotspot active print count-only]

:local activePPPoE [/ppp active print count-only]
:local totalPPPoE [/ppp secret print count-only]
:local inactivePPPoE ($totalPPPoE - $activePPPoE)

:local FreeMemory ([/system resource get free-memory] / 1024 / 1024)
:local TotalMemory ([/system resource get total-memory] / 1024 / 1024)

:local FreeHdd ([/system resource get free-hdd-space] / 1024 / 1024)
:local TotalHdd ([/system resource get total-hdd-space] / 1024 / 1024)

:local BadBlock [/system resource get bad-block]

# =====================
# INACTIVE LIST
# =====================
:local inactiveList ""
:local count 0

:foreach i in=[/ppp secret find] do={
    :if ($count >= 10) do={ :break }

    :local user [/ppp secret get $i name]

    :if ([:len [/ppp active find name=$user]] = 0) do={
        :set inactiveList ($inactiveList . "ðŸ”´ " . $user . "%0A")
        :set count ($count + 1)
    }
}

# =====================
# ISOLIR LIST
# =====================
:local isolirList ""
:local isolirCount 0

:foreach i in=[/ppp secret find profile=ISOLIR] do={
    :local user [/ppp secret get $i name]
    :set isolirList ($isolirList . "ðŸš« " . $user . "%0A")
    :set isolirCount ($isolirCount + 1)
}

:if ($isolirCount = 0) do={
    :set isolirList "Tidak ada user%0A"
}

# =====================
# BUILD MESSAGE
# =====================
:local msg ""

:set msg ($msg . "ðŸ“ˆ Router Report%0A=================%0A")
:set msg ($msg . "ðŸ†” Router: " . $sysNameTrans . "%0A")
:set msg ($msg . "ðŸ’» Model: " . $model . "%0A")
:set msg ($msg . "ðŸ’¬ Version: " . $version . "%0A")
:set msg ($msg . "ðŸ•” Uptime: " . $uptime . "%0A")
:set msg ($msg . "ðŸš¦ CPU Load: " . $cpuLoad . "%25%0A")
:set msg ($msg . "ðŸš¥ Free Memory: " . $FreeMemory . " MiB%0A")
:set msg ($msg . "ðŸš¥ Total Memory: " . $TotalMemory . " MiB%0A")
:set msg ($msg . "ðŸ“¦ Free HDD: " . $FreeHdd . " MiB%0A")
:set msg ($msg . "ðŸ“¦ Total HDD: " . $TotalHdd . " MiB%0A")
:set msg ($msg . "ðŸž Bad Block: " . $BadBlock . "%25%0A")
:set msg ($msg . "ðŸ‘¤ Hotspot User: " . $hotspot . "%0A")

:set msg ($msg . "ðŸ‘¤ PPPoE Summary:%0A")
:set msg ($msg . "   Total   : " . $totalPPPoE . "%0A")
:set msg ($msg . "   Active  : " . $activePPPoE . "%0A")
:set msg ($msg . "   Inactive: " . $inactivePPPoE . "%0A")
:set msg ($msg . "   Isolir  : " . $isolirCount . "%0A")

:set msg ($msg . "%0AðŸ“‹ In-Active User List:%0A" . $inactiveList)
:set msg ($msg . "%0AðŸš« User Isolir (" . $isolirCount . "):%0A" . $isolirList)

:set msg ($msg . "%0AðŸ“‰ Interface: " . $ifaceA . " RX: " . $rxMBA . " MiB - TX: " . $txMBA . " MiB")

# =====================
# SEND TO TELEGRAM
# =====================
/tool fetch \
url=("https://api.telegram.org/bot" . $botToken . "/sendMessage") \
http-method=post \
http-header-field="Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded" \
http-data=("chat_id=" . $chatId . "&text=" . $msg) \
keep-result=no
